utz.jpg.giveaway: Reads as real. Hand-spread, uneven buttercream with drag marks and a lumpy, slightly lopsided rim; toasted/crumb speckle on the top edge; wax candles of mixed kinds (plain cream, red/white and blue/white spirals) pushed in at different angles and depths; small teardrop flames with a blue base and a soft halo; the red piped characters are wobbly and hand-made. Dark polka-dot side decorations sink into the frosting rather than sitting on it. Heavy compression blocking, soft optical focus and a pale out-of-focus band across the top of frame look like a sourced video frame. The cake has real mass: light falls off across a curved, irregular surface instead of a clean cylinder.

lgx.jpg.giveaway: Reads as real. Pale yellow cake whose frosting is hand-smoothed, with a visible horizontal swipe line and an irregular top edge; dark dots embedded at irregular spacing; seven thin candles of mismatched colour and height, flames small and warm with real smoke/heat shimmer above; red lettering partly hidden on top. Sits on a thin metal board on a dim, low-contrast tabletop that fades into darkness with soft, wide falloff and no hard spotlight edge. Mild compression and a faint light band at frame top, consistent with the other real frame.

kff.jpg.giveaway: Best of the renders but still CG. Cake is a perfect cylinder with a mathematically clean ellipse top and a crisp piped rope border on top and bottom; top has a regular grid/waffle shading pattern (texture or shader tiling) instead of trowel marks. Candles are straight, uniform cylinders with flat stripes; flames are opaque white spheres/billboards with a glow, no teardrop shape, no blue base, no wick. The red characters plus a large 'N'/lightning stroke look like decals floating flat on the surface, not piped icing. Side dots are identical lavender spheres evenly spaced on the surface. Sides are near black while top is bright orange - lit only from directly above with no bounce light. Grain is an even digital overlay, not film/compression texture. Colour is a uniform orange grade, too saturated.

aov.jpg.giveaway: Camera looks almost straight down so the cake reads as a flat disc/tambourine with no visible side height; ellipse is perfectly regular. Seven candles are identical brown-striped cylinders in an even ring, each topped by an identical white bulb flame. Lettering is a faint embossed decal, barely legible. Lavender pearl dots ring the base at perfect intervals. A hard-edged orange pool of light falls below on an invisible floor - spotlight cone shape with no table. Surface has a fine regular dither/stipple, no frosting relief. Everything is soft in a uniform, synthetic way rather than lens depth-of-field.

eyv.jpg.giveaway: Has a table, which helps, but the table is a featureless pale slab with perfectly straight edges, a hard rectangular silhouette and a uniform cream colour; its front face and underside are a flat band with a cylindrical pedestal leg dimly visible below - looks like primitive geometry. Cake is wrong: two-tier dark chocolate cylinder with diagonal procedural streaks (noise texture) and stick-like 'sprinkles' arranged in rows; real frames show a pale buttercream cake. Candles are six (not seven visible) thin rods in a straight row cropped at frame top with round white ball flames. Cake top glows yellow while the sides are muddy; the table is lit evenly edge to edge with no falloff around the cake and no candlelight warmth on it. Even grain overlay. Composition is a head-on, centred, eye-level product shot.

zuf.jpg.giveaway: Same scene as eyv: geometric slab table with a hard rectangular outline, flat front edge, visible cylindrical pedestal under it, and an orange hot spot on the floor below that has no source. Chocolate cylinder cake with streaky noise texture and repeated dark stick decorations; top lit flat yellow. Candles: identical thin sticks with white sphere flames, lined up like a row of pins, cropped by the top of frame. No contact shadow between cake board and table. Table surface is uniformly bright and clean with no wood grain, cloth, or falloff.

tqd.jpg.giveaway: Same template as eyv/zuf. Table is a large flat box with sharp corners and a thick, evenly lit front edge; it fills the width of frame. Two stacked chocolate cylinders with diagonal stripe texture, rows of identical dark sticks, a separate thin rim plate. Candle flames are white spheres clipped by the top edge, so the key element is cut off. No candle glow falls on the table; the light is a broad even overhead fill. The shot is centred and symmetric like a 3D viewport default.

fft.jpg.giveaway: Darker variant of the slab-table scene: cake sides almost entirely black, so the cake reads as a dark drum with a pale lid. Table top is an evenly lit cream trapezoid with crisp straight edges and a hard dark band below; no pedestal visible, no surface detail. Candle flames are blown-out white blobs merging at the top edge of frame. Diagonal stick decorations repeat regularly. No falloff, no warmth from candles on the cake or table.

jtq.jpg.giveaway: Cake framed so the candles are cut off at the top; mostly a tall dark cylinder with a perfectly flat orange disc top showing a regular woven/grid texture. Piped rope borders at top and bottom are perfect tori. Lavender spheres placed on the side in a scattered but identical way with dark vertical streaks under each (shadow or texture artifact). Decal lettering at top right is a pink smear. Floats in black with a spot-lit floor glow at bottom: no table. Edges of the ellipse are clean vector-like.

cbc.jpg.giveaway: Worst composition: top of cake cut by the frame, candles almost entirely off-frame, only stubs and one striped candle visible. Dark cylinder with dozens of identical lavender spheres each casting an identical dark vertical streak - reads like pins in a drum. Grid-textured flat top, perfect rope border. Strong orange spotlight cone below on an invisible floor with no table. Colour cast is a single saturated orange with no neutral or cool tones anywhere.
